title: Unusual Indices
subtitle: How strange comparisons make complex realities readable
author: Anton BV
audience: General readers who enjoy Freakonomics-style popular economics, strange indicators, readable data stories and counterintuitive nonfiction.
positioning: A popular-nonfiction book about how unusual indices turn abstract systems into memorable everyday comparisons, with commercial reader value taking priority over owner-project promotion.
description: Edition-1 seed only. This is a bounded commercial BookSpec draft for narrowing scope before any manuscript generation or KDP packaging.
source_policy: Owner-originated material and approved ABVX content may be transformed. Third-party examples remain reference-only unless separately cleared.
citation_policy: Non-obvious factual or historical claims should trace to explicit sources; external index descriptions should retain source provenance.
